listing.name: Def Jam: Fight for NY — DefJam GameCube recomp (Nakamizake) (Nakamizake)
listing.summary: The project describes a native player. Complete-campaign and online-play claims remain unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA GNWE69 plain ISO. RVZ, GCZ, WIA and CISO are not accepted.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the installer with your own disc. It supplies the player, compiler and recompiler and builds the game locally. A profile-guided session is optional.

warnings: The project describes a native player. Complete-campaign and online-play claims remain unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
